subject.title: refactor: prune unsupported OPENCLAW env overrides

question: Is `OPENCLAW_TELEMETRY` still a supported packaged-launcher contract that must remain during this cleanup, or may it be removed after all shipped launchers are migrated?
rationale: The source explicitly identifies packaged launcher control, but the PR treats the variable as unsupported; only maintainers can confirm the intended shipped compatibility boundary.

options.title: Preserve and migrate first
options.body: Keep the override in this PR, migrate packaged launchers to the canonical control, and remove it later with upgrade proof.

options.title: Approve immediate removal
options.body: Intentionally remove the override only after documenting the launcher decision and providing real upgrade evidence that no supported package relies on it.

recommendation.title: Preserve and migrate first
recommendation.body: Keep the override in this PR, migrate packaged launchers to the canonical control, and remove it later with upgrade proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They sponsored the audit, authored the classification, and are best positioned to confirm whether packaged launcher control remains intentional.
